analysis:
Reviewed both supplied local analyses together against the canonical definition index and detailed T-041. Both identify the same change: provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/KVCacheSSD/SSDPrefixCache.swift:1773–1778 delegates LRU eviction to SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest. They report that the safe-root gate, retireIndexedEntries deletion path (1785–1835), and positive-freed-byte statistics check remain in place. Neither analysis establishes a concrete regression; delegation alone does not prove weakened disk-budget enforcement.
The material integration question remains unresolved: inspect SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest with the index, retireIndexedEntries and SSDDiskBudget to verify bounded traversal, progress past undeletable victims, termination on externalChange, index reconciliation and accurate freed-byte accounting. These contracts support T-041's LRU mitigation and availability (A-018), including adversarial or inaccessible selected storage.
The analyses also report unchanged scoped HMAC identities, authenticated binding checks, donation limits, staging reservations and release paths. No supplied evidence establishes new exposure of prompts or keys, weakened account isolation, or changes to authorization, attestation, wire encryption or billing. However, integration_source replays no source and explicitly omits all four reviewed source units; the reported line references and preservation claims cannot be independently verified in this pass. Further source review of the eviction helper and its budget interactions is required before clearing the refactor. Missing implementation is a coverage limit, not a vulnerability finding or evidence of safety.
